programs.title: The Cotswolds With Pam Ayres
programs.desc: The poet's journey begins south of the Cotswolds at Longleat House, the country estate in Wiltshire. Set in 1,000 acres of grounds, Longleat Safari Park opened in 1966 - the first of its kind in the UK - although it wasn't without controversy. Pam meets Lord Bath to learn more about the park history.
